confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Japanese regional city prices, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with Dogo Onsen demand and event dates. The yen level is assumed from general knowledge and may differ from July 2026 conditions. FX: the 2026-10-15 value (0.6955) is attributed in search results to the RBA exchange rates overview page, which I could not open directly. A third-party page lists 0.6947 for 2026-10-16, which I did not use because it is not confirmed against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced like other mid-sized regional Japanese cities such as Takamatsu and Okayama. Accommodation is nudged up for Dogo Onsen tourism and for July being a non-off-season month in Shikoku.
